description:
List documents in a library folder, or at the root if no folder is given.

    Args:
        folder_id: Folder UUID to list (optional — omit for root-level items)
        offset: Skip this many items (default 0)
        limit: Page size (default 50, max 100)

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: list_library_items
title: List library items
